title: DevOps Engineer
description:
TG Lab is a technology company powering some of the biggest winners in sports betting and online casino products. We provide player account management and engagement technology to industry leaders such as Stake.com, Belgium National Lottery, Betsson Group, and many others. Our innovative yet practical solutions fuel world-class real-money wagering technology that supports over 1 million players. Our iGaming software is designed for distribution to casino and sportsbook operators across the EU, USA, and other international markets.

We are looking for data-driven innovators who want to shape the future of iGaming and make a real impact on the industry. We value integrity, a curious mindset, empathy, and a commitment to quality. If you are eager to learn, unafraid of challenges, and ready to grow with a like-minded team — we want to hear from you.

Role

As a DevOps Engineer, you will be responsible for the design, development, testing, and deployment of products that help companies engage with their customers in efficient and personal ways.

Our technology stack is built in Scala, NodeJS, and Ruby on Rails, running on Cassandra, MongoDB, ElasticSearch, and Kafka. We containerize and deploy with Kubernetes on AWS. You will be responsible for service delivery, reliability, scalability, monitoring, and helping define all this as immutable infrastructure-as-code.

Responsibilities

  • Deploy and maintain critical applications on cloud-native microservices architecture.
  • Implement automation, effective monitoring, and infrastructure-as-code.
  • Deploy and maintain CI/CD pipelines across multiple environments.
  • Support and work alongside a cross-functional engineering team on the latest technologies.
  • Iterate on best practices to increase the quality & velocity of deployments.
  • Sustain and improve the process of knowledge sharing throughout the engineering team.

Requirements

  • Experience deploying and maintaining scalable, resilient and highly available systems in cloud environments.
  • Skills in automation of repetitive tasks (scripting via Bash, Python, Ruby).
  • Practical experience with Docker containerization and clustering (Kubernetes, ECS, Rancher).
  • Expertise with AWS (e.g., IAM, EC2, VPC, ELB, ALB, Autoscaling, Lambda).
  • Experience with version control system (e.g., Git, Gitlab).
  • Experience with configuration management tools (e.g., Ansible, Chef).
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code (e.g., Terraform, CloudFormation.
  • Good written and verbal communication skills in English.

Working with us implies

  • Memorable company parties and social activities like team buildings and monthly birthday celebrations.
  • Working in a company with a global culture, experience, and reach.
  • Working on-site in our modern, bright, and comfortable office space located in downtown Foz do Iguaçu, with a great working atmosphere, a collaborative team of amazing people, and open-minded managers.
  • Opportunities to build valuable skills, work with unique and interesting projects for the sports industry, express and implement your ideas and grow your career.

The monthly salary range will depend on the selected candidate's experience and skills. We will contact only shortlisted candidates.

Estimular a cultura de aprendizado contínuo e inovação técnica.

title: Hardware Test & Verification Designer
description:
At TOPIC (in the Netherlands) we work every day on high-tech innovations to make the world smarter, healthier, and better. Are you a highly driven and ambitious Hardware Test & Verification Designer

with a passion for designing, developing, and executing cutting-edge hardware testing, and ready to make a real impact on product quality and innovation?

"There is a lot of flexibility to educate yourself."

Gijs van Esch I Hardware Engineer at TOPIC Embedded Systems

What will you do as a Hardware Test & Verification Designer?

As a Hardware Test & Verification Designer you are responsible for designing, developing, and executing hardware testing and validation for complex embedded systems. Applies strong electronics knowledge (schematics, PCB design, signal behavior) to optimize performance and identify issues. Develops and maintains automated test scripts (Python required; LabVIEW, TestStand, or C/C++ preferred) and conducts HIL, reliability, and environmental testing.

Your responsibilities as a Hardware Test & Verification Designer:

  • Design, develop, and execute hardware testing, validation, and verification activities for embedded systems, ensuring product reliability and compliance;
  • Apply a solid understanding of electronics, schematics, PCB design, and signal behavior to identify potential issues and optimize hardware performance;
  • Conduct and support HIL (Hardware-in-the-Loop) testing, as well as reliability and environmental qualification testing;
  • Collaborate closely with embedded software and firmware teams; a hands-on programming mindset is preferred;
  • Work in a structured, plan-oriented manner, maintaining high accuracy in documentation, traceability, and reporting;
  • Take a consultative approach, translating test results into clear and valuable recommendations for design improvements and product optimization;
  • Act as a technical consultant, capable of operating across different customer environments to ensure quality, robustness, and regulatory compliance of embedded hardware products.

What do we offer you?

This will make you smarter:

  • Strategic projects in complex high-tech environments
  • Collaborate with other senior engineers and domain experts
  • Access to advanced training through our TOPIC Academy
  • Contribute to and lead tech events and knowledge sessions

This will make you better:

  • Permanent contract
  • An all-in benefits package (€62.000 – €82.000 annually) including 13th month, mobility, pension, extra holidays
  • 26 vacation days (option to buy extra), pension scheme, relocation support

This will keep you healthy:

  • Good work-life balance, flexible hours, and hybrid working
  • Inspiring office with daily fresh fruit and a gym
  • Home office support for an inspiring work-from-home setup
  • Regular fun, social, and sports events

What do you bring as a Hardware Test & Verification Designer?

  • A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electronics, Computer Science, Embedded Systems, or a related technical field;
  • 5+ years in hardware testing, validation, and verification;
  • Strong understanding of electronics, schematics, PCB design, and signal behavior;
  • Proficient in Python (required); experience with LabVIEW, TestStand, or C/C++ is a plus;
  • Familiarity with HIL testing, reliability testing, and environmental testing;
  • Affinity with embedded software and firmware; hands-on programming skills are preferred;
  • Plan-oriented and accurate, with strong skills in documentation, traceability, and reporting;
  • Able to interpret test results and translate them into actionable recommendations;
  • Comfortable acting as a technical consultant across various customer environments, ensuring the quality, reliability, and compliance of embedded hardware products;
  • A good command of English, and preferably Dutch language.

Our organization

Since 1996 we have been developing (embedded) systems that are essential for products manufactured by renowned high-tech companies around the world. Our projects involve edge to cloud solutions; from PCB design and FPGA to low level embedded software and application software for UI, Web, Mobile and cloud. We are well known for our high level of knowledge and expertise and are proud to be a Premier Embedded Computing Partner of AMD; technology leader in the field of System-on-Chips and FPGAs.

Diversity & Inclusion

At TOPIC, we believe that true innovation happens when people with different backgrounds, ideas, and perspectives come together. Every talent counts, and every voice matters. Diversity strengthens our creativity, and inclusion ensures that everyone feels welcome and valued. We build a culture where everyone has the space to contribute and be themselves.

title: Director of Sales LATAM
description:
JoVE is the world-leading producer and provider of science video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Universidade de São Paulo (USP), Tecnológico de Monterrey (ITESM), Universidad Nacional Autónoma de México (UNAM) and Universidad de los Andes. As a rapidly growing company with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India, servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.

The Role

We are seeking a dynamic and results-oriented professional to join our team as Director of Sales. In this key role, you will lead a team of Account Executives, drive growth, and contribute to JoVE's ongoing success in the Latin America market.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the regional sales team to consistently meet & exceed assigned revenue targets in the LATAM region.
  • Provide strategic leadership and oversight of the sales team's activities, driving new business acquisition and expanding existing accounts.
  • Recruit, mentor, and develop sales talent to grow and expand the reach of JoVE's extensive library of STEM video titles.
  • Define, implement, and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) for the sales team, regularly assessing progress and making adjustments to ensure success.
  • Analyze buyer and influencer motivations, competitive dynamics, and the sales cycle to prioritize and refine sales strategies.
  • Collaborate with marketing, customer success, and other teams to ensure alignment of sales efforts with company objectives and goals.
  • Successfully plan and manage renewal projects with existing clients.

Requirements

  • A Bachelor's degree.
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience leading sales teams in Higher Education publishing, EdTech, or STEM publishing industries.
  • 10+ years of experience in sales, preferably in the Higher Education sector.
  • Proven track record of success in sales leadership roles.
  • Target-oriented and willing to work in a fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

Why Join JoVE?

  • A competitive compensation package including unlimited commissions on your sales
  • You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and education.
  • Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us

title: Accounting Supervisor
description:
We are seeking an experienced and detail-oriented Accounting Supervisor to lead day-to-day accounting operations for our aftermarket automotive business. This role is responsible for ensuring accurate and timely financial reporting, overseeing general ledger activity, supporting internal and external audits, and ensuring compliance with corporate accounting policies and local regulations.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Supervise daily accounting operations, including accounts payable, accounts receivable, fixed assets, and general ledger entries.
  • Review and prepare monthly journal entries, account reconciliations, and variance analyses.
  • Ensure timely and accurate month-end, quarter-end, and year-end closings.
  • Maintain compliance with internal controls, company policies, and accounting standards (US GAAP/IFRS as applicable).
  • Support external and internal audits by preparing required documentation and responding to inquiries.
  • Assist with preparation of financial statements and management reporting packages.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Finance, Operations, and Corporate Accounting.
  • Train, mentor, and supervise accounting staff; provide performance feedback and support professional development.
  • Identify process improvement opportunities and support system implementations or upgrades.

  • Pacote office generalista
  • Conhecimento ADP
  • Excel intermediário
  • Conhecimentos e análise crítica de legislação trabalhista

Sobre a Ardagh:

Globalmente, a AMP opera 24 instalações de produção nas Américas e Europa, empregando cerca de 5.800 funcionários e registrou receitas de US $ 4 bilhões em 2021. A inclusão, confiança, trabalho em equipe e excelência são nossos valores e junto com o talento que buscamos, serão a fórmula perfeita para crescermos juntos!

Somos apaixonados por sustentabilidade e temos uma ótima reputação pela inovação e qualidade que oferecemos a nossos clientes. Nós somos pioneiros em novos métodos de produção, novas técnicas de design e novas formas de reciclar e economizar energia. Nosso objetivo é reduzir os impactos ambientais, enquanto permanecemos economicamente sustentáveis e socialmente responsáveis.

Na Ardagh, temos a consciência da singularidade de cada ser humano. Valorizamos e respeitamos a diversidade da nossa rede de colaboradores. Aqui, você pode ser você, contribuindo com suas experiências para o nosso negócio. Afinal, cada um é um mundo, e, na Ardagh, todo mundo importa! Gostou? #VEM ser você :)

Se seu perfil corresponde à vaga, candidate-se a essa posição e #VEMserLateiroAMP.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.

  • Estruturar e conduzir operações de mercado de capitais, incluindo emissões de debêntures, bonds e operações de equity (ações preferenciais privadas).

  • Formação: Administração, Economia, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas; pós-graduação ou MBA em Finanças será considerado diferencial.

description:
Role: Trilingual Technical Support

Location: near Santo Amaro Station / Giovani Gronchi. Sao Paulo | Brazil – CENESP

Languages required: Portuguese+ Spanish+ English

Salary: BRL 2450/month

The Internal/External Customer, Technical Support Representative provides Internal/External Customer Technical Support Services and supports our client's customers in their navigation and use of applications, hardware and software necessary to complete actions related to doing business with our client. The primary function of these Help Desk services is to restore technical function as resolution in order to allow our client's customer to return to their business process as quickly as possible. In relation to this service, the activities conducted by the Technical Support Representative would include the following:

  • Interacting with our client's customers who are contacting customer support for assistance via phone/email (potential future channels e.g. Chat)
  • Collecting and verifying information provided from the contact in order to accurately and quickly deliver solutions that restore service

  • Working within a service management application to provide case logs for restoration rate accountability and process adherence
  • Escalating unresolved issues to the next level of support when required by process
  • Adhering to Priority service levels and assigning these appropriately for the described issue using provided support processes.

This position is the first point of contact for the end-user. Individuals must be able to multi-task in a fast paced, high pressure environment with customers of varying degrees of technical knowledge. Individuals will have common solutions available for technical problems encountered and will escalate if no knowledge-based solution exists. Individuals are required to identify and define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions. TSR must be able to understand and interpret technical concepts and apply logic and deductive reasoning. Performs basic troubleshooting and ID resets for various applications.

Job Duties

  • Engage with first level support contacts from internal/external end-users
  • 1-2 years of experience
  • Communicate resolution to software/hardware errors & malfunctions
  • Provide feedback on procedures
  • Troubleshoot/dispatch basic hardware issues
  • Probe, isolate, and troubleshoot supported application problems
  • Handle general ID resets, email issues, Internet Explorer issues
  • Responsible for meeting established individual and team performance targets including service level, resolution, productivity and quality standards
  • Maintain up-to-date knowledge of products, services, and resource materials to provide adequate support and accurate information to customers
  • Provide first level triage and resolution for in scope issues and applications using existing knowledge base articles and/or SOPs defined.
  • Adhere to established attendance and punctuality guidelines

Preferred Competencies

Technical ability regarding the following:

  • Cloud Application support related to internet browsers
  • Ability to understand and troubleshoot hardware and software issues remotely through screen sharing software
  • Ability to identify, adapt, and apply approaches in problem solving
  • Overall cursory understanding of ecommerce web sites and APIs

This is a partial list of activities and may be expanded as necessary in the customer service training or amended at any time by our client through a Change Control Procedure.

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

title: Senior Sales Executive
description:
Working At Bitso

We are a diverse team that takes pride in understanding the perspectives of others. We fully embrace working remotely and we are eager to act, improve and accelerate progress inside and outside of our organization.

To drive revolutionary changes in society and make crypto useful, we delight our customers with world-class products, deep care, and intentional empathy.

Your Purpose

As a Sales Top Executive, you will be at the forefront of our growth strategy, tasked with winning commercial deals in key markets/verticals. Your role is not just about selling; it's about understanding customer pain points, leveraging our unique selling propositions (USP), and developing targeted commercial offers. Success in this role involves collaboration, strategic thinking, and meticulous pipeline management.

Reports To

Head of Sales

Who You Are

  • 10 years of experience in a sales position.
  • +4 years of experience selling remittances, cross-border payment and/or complex payments solutions.
  • Developed and executed comprehensive sales strategies for institutional and corporate clients.
  • Previous sales experience at a financial institution/large brokerage firm.
  • English fluency
  • Proven experience in business development and sales as a hunter.
  • Strong understanding of commercial strategy and pre-sales support
  • Excellent communication and negotiation skills.
  • Experience with CRM tools, preferably Hubspot.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with internal teams for seamless customer onboarding.

What You Will Do

  • Engage with potential customers, understand their pain points, and effectively communicate our USP (Unique Selling Proposition) to win new business.
  • Collaborate with Marketing to identify potential customers and provide structured feedback on generated leads.
  • Identify customer pain points and formulate targeted commercial offers to address their specific needs.
  • 360 sales cycle, open and close new business.
  • Document, track, and analyze the sales pipeline using the CRM tool (Hubspot) to ensure a robust and well-managed sales process.
  • Maintain, refresh, and expand the sales funnel, working closely with Sales Ops to track key performance indicators (KPIs) and provide regular updates to Senior Management.
  • Collaborate with various functions (e.g., KYC, Legal, Product) to facilitate a smooth customer onboarding process, ensuring a successful transition to production.
  • Work closely with the Account Manager during onboarding to ensure revenue targets are achieved, and customers have an exceptional experience.

Research in Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion suggests that individuals may hesitate to apply for jobs if they do not meet all the listed criteria. At Bitso, we value diversity and your unique strengths could be just what we're looking for. If this role excites you but you don't match every point in the description, we still want to hear from you.

Who We Are

With over 9 million users, Bitso is the leading cryptocurrency platform in Latin America. We are developing the cryptocurrency ecosystem in the region and enabling financial inclusion. We believe crypto is the future of finance, and we're committed to making it useful by providing equal access to safe and intuitive financial products.

When we hire people for our team, we specifically test for the following traits in addition to our cultural values:

  • Mission-Driven: We seek individuals who are passionate about crypto and Bitso's mission and resilient in facing industry challenges
  • High Sense of Urgency: We prioritize candidates who demonstrate a high sense of urgency and responsibility.
  • Exceptional Hard Skills: We seek individuals who possess exceptional skills in their respective fields, with no room for mediocrity.
  • Self-Management: We look for individuals who can independently manage their work, career, and professional development.

Compensation & Benefits

At Bitso, you are taking the front seat on the edge of crypto innovation, creating the next generation of crypto-powered products.

So for those willing to commit, adapt and pioneer the most important change of the century we offer:

  • Me Time program, including unlimited paid time off.
  • Remote-first work environment.
  • Employee Stock Option program.
  • Zero trading fees through our Bitso Alpha app.
  • Extended Family Leave Policy: all birthing parents, non-birthing parents and adopting parents are eligible for a 4-months leave.
  • Premium health, dental and life insurances in Mexico, Gibraltar, Colombia, USA, Brazil and Argentina.
  • Monthly stipend for gym memberships, relaxation activities, sports equipment, cooking classes, books, entertainment and more.

Want to leave an undoubtedly legacy with us? Fasten your seatbelt and join this spaceship, where you will find exponential growth and the opportunity to thrive!

title: Analista de FP&A
description:
Venha fazer parte do maior projeto privado de regeneração urbana e revitalização patrimonial do Brasil. Edifícios centenários, hospitalidade, moda, arte, cultura, gastronomia e natureza como parte do seu cotidiano!

Sua missão será:

Contribuir para a excelência do processo de gestão financeira da companhia por meio do planejamento e acompanhamento de resultados, assegurando análises precisas, insights estratégicos e suporte às áreas de negócio na tomada de decisão. Atuar de forma integrada entre o planejamento financeiro e o business partner, garantindo o alinhamento entre metas, execução e performance corporativa.

Principais atribuições e responsabilidades:

Elaborar, consolidar e acompanhar o budget anual, forecast e projeções de resultados (DRE, fluxo de caixa e indicadores financeiros).

• Realizar análises de variação entre realizado e planejado, identificando riscos, oportunidades e recomendações de ação.

• Apoiar as áreas de negócio como business partner, traduzindo informações financeiras em indicadores operacionais e planos de ação.

• Desenvolver e manter modelos financeiros e relatórios gerenciais que suportem o processo decisório e o planejamento estratégico.

• Consolidar informações de diferentes fontes (ERP, BI, planilhas) e garantir a acurácia e integridade dos dados financeiros.

• Participar ativamente de reuniões de performance, reuniões de resultados e revisões de metas.

• Apoiar a área na automação de processos e melhoria contínua dos modelos e ferramentas de controle.

• Garantir o cumprimento de prazos corporativos e padrões de governança financeira definidos pela companhia.

Atuação:

O(a) Analista Financeiro (FP&A) atuará de forma integrada ao time de planejamento e controladoria, sendo responsável por elaborar e acompanhar orçamentos, projeções e resultados financeiros, além de realizar análises de variação e consolidação de dados. Dará suporte às áreas de negócio, fornecendo informações e relatórios que auxiliem na tomada de decisão e no atingimento das metas corporativas. Também contribuirá para a melhoria contínua dos processos financeiros, automação de controles e padronização de modelos de análise e performance.

Competências:

• Visão analítica e orientação para resultados.

• Capacidade de influenciar e se comunicar com diferentes níveis da organização.

• Organização, autonomia e atenção a detalhes.

• Postura colaborativa e foco em melhoria contínua.

• Curiosidade e mentalidade crítica para propor soluções financeiras e operacionais.

• Formação superior completa em Administração, Economia, Engenharia, Contabilidade ou áreas correlatas.

• Experiência prévia em FP&A, controladoria ou áreas financeiras estratégicas.

• Domínio de Excel avançado e Power BI; conhecimento em sistemas ERP (SAP, Oracle, Totvs ou similares).

• Capacidade de elaborar análises financeiras, apresentações executivas e modelagens de cenários.

• Inglês intermediário ou avançado será considerado diferencial.

Habilidades em:

• Visão analítica e orientação para resultados.

• Capacidade de influenciar e se comunicar com diferentes níveis da organização.

title: Senior Software Architect
description:
About Specialty Capital

Specialty Capital was founded just four years ago with a bold idea - to give "debanked" small businesses access to capital that's Simple, Smart, and Reliable. Today, the company is among the top revenue-based finance companies in the U.S., serving thousands of merchants through a combination of speed, technology, and a deeply human approach. We're now entering our next chapter and scaling into new financial verticals (credit cards, payments, and neo-bank integrations) and expanding internationally, starting with Canada. The company is profitable, founder-led, and growing rapidly with a culture built on grit, ownership, and mission.

Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced Technical Architect to shape the technological foundation of our rapidly growing small business lending platform. This fully remote position offers the opportunity to design and implement cutting-edge financial technology solutions while working with a dynamic team focused on revolutionizing business financing. The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in mobile application development and financial services technology to help us build scalable, secure, and innovative lending solutions.

Key Responsibilities

Architecture & Technical Strategy

  • Design and evolve the comprehensive technical architecture for our lending platform, ensuring scalability, reliability, and security
  • Define and maintain architectural standards, patterns, and best practices across all technology initiatives
  • Lead technology selection and evaluation processes for new tools, frameworks, and platforms
  • Create technical roadmaps aligned with business objectives and product strategy
  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship to development teams

Mobile Application Architecture

  • Architect and oversee the development of native mobile applications for iOS and Android platforms
  • Design mobile solutions that deliver exceptional user experiences for loan applications and account management
  • Ensure seamless integration between mobile applications and backend services
  • Optimize mobile application performance and offline capabilities

Platform Development

  • Collaborate with SaaS vendors to ensure platform configurations align with architectural standards
  • Design and implement API strategies for internal and external integrations
  • Architect microservices and serverless solutions using cloud services
  • Develop architecture strategies for analytics, reporting, and machine learning
  • Implement AI and automation solutions to streamline lending processes

Security & Compliance

  • Define security architecture and implement defense-in-depth strategies
  • Ensure architectural compliance with financial industry regulations and standards
  • Design secure data handling and encryption strategies for sensitive financial information
  • Lead security reviews and threat modeling exercises
  • Implement monitoring and incident response architectures

Technical Leadership

  • Provide hands-on technical expertise in node.js, React, Swift, Java/Kotlin development
  • Review code, architectures, and technical designs to ensure quality and standards
  • Facilitate technical discussions and decision-making across teams
  • Establish development standards, coding practices, and documentation requirements
  • Drive continuous improvement in development processes and technical practices

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field; Master's degree preferred
  • 10-15 years of progressive experience in software architecture and development
  • Required: Extensive experience in mobile application development for iOS and Android platforms
  • Strong expertise in Swift for iOS and Java/Kotlin for Android development
  • Proven experience with financial technology platforms and payment systems
  • Deep knowledge of cloud architecture
  • Experience with node.js, React, mySQL, and modern web technologies
  • Strong background in API design, microservices, and distributed systems
  • Experience with ETL processes, data pipelines, and reporting solutions
  • Understanding of cybersecurity best practices and financial services regulations
  • Excellent communication skills with ability to translate technical concepts to business stakeholders

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in small business lending or commercial finance
  • Experience with Large Language Models / ML implementations in financial services
  • Knowledge of loan origination systems and credit decisioning platforms
  • Experience with React Native or cross-platform mobile development frameworks

What We Offer

  • Fully remote position with flexible working arrangements
  • Competitive compensation package commensurate with experience
  • Comprehensive benefits including health, dental, and vision insurance
  • Opportunity to shape the technical direction of a growing fintech company
  • Professional development opportunities and conference attendance
  • Collaborative environment with a focus on innovation and impact

Join Specialty Capital and play a pivotal role in revolutionizing small business lending through innovative technology solutions. As our Technical Architect, you'll have the opportunity to design systems that directly impact thousands of businesses across the country, helping them access the capital they need to grow and thrive.

Specialty Capital is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive team.

title: Analista de suporte técnico externo
description:
A Soutag é uma startup que nasceu em Belo Horizonte/MG e nossa missão é levar economia e vantagens para os motoristas profissionais, principalmente nos combustíveis. O que nos move é o impacto financeiro e social que nosso produto leva para as famílias desses e dessas motoristas de aplicativo, taxistas, caminhoneiros, e demais categorias que ganham a vida dirigindo.

Já contamos com milhares de usuários na plataforma e centenas de postos parceiros. Encontramos product-market fit, já iniciamos nossa expansão nacional e estamos desenvolvendo novos produtos, como a operação de uma carteira digital. Precisamos de pessoas com muita energia, visão estratégica e capacidade de execução para construir esse próximo capítulo da empresa com a gente.

Papel na Soutag:

A principal responsabilidade da vaga é assegurar que os postos de combustíveis parceiros permaneçam estáveis tecnicamente e online na plataforma.

Responsabilidades:

  • Monitorar e manter a operação eficiente junto aos sistemas dos postos parceiros, identificando e solucionando problemas técnicos rapidamente;
  • Realizar manutenção preventiva e corretiva em sistemas de automação, redes, aplicativos em todo o ecossistema Soutag;
  • Documentar processos de manutenção e fornecer relatórios de status operacional;
  • Colaborar na criação de planos de ação para resolver problemas técnicos;
  • Realizar testes e validações das soluções implementadas;
  • Atender os times de pista para esclarecer dúvidas;
  • Registrar atendimentos e soluções nas plataformas de trabalho.

Requisitos:

  • É imprescindível ter moto própria e habilitação para essa vaga;
  • Ensino superior completo ou em andamento;
  • Experiência de 1 a 3 anos em suporte técnico ou funções correlatas;
  • Ótima comunicação verbal e escrita;
  • Conhecimento em redes de computadores e automação para postos de combustíveis;
  • Habilidade para resolver problemas e trabalhar em equipe;
  • Empatia, proatividade e energia para aprender e inovar;
  • Organização e capacidade de gerenciar o tempo;
  • Flexibilidade e busca constante por aprendizado.

Aqui você vai encontrar:

Venha crescer junto com a gente, fazendo parte de um ambiente inspirador, rico em aprendizados e trabalhando por um propósito que está impactando a vida de muitas pessoas!

title: Sr Functional Analyst Manufacturing (São José dos Campos/SP)
description:
Primary purpose of the position:

Responsible for leading efforts to analyze and define detailed specifications for business systems which map to business processes. Performs as an expert at driving solution delivery by facilitating requirements analysis and design activities with the business to accurately determine future system requirements. Ensures solutions are in alignment with the enterprise architecture blueprint, the solutions architecture and ensures that systems and application designs adhere to standards and policies. Ensures that all information technology investments are clearly aligned with the priorities of the business. Responsible for team guidance and delivery of complex, technical solutions to business needs.

Essential Responsible Areas:

  • Leads efforts to elicit future systems requirements using interviews, document analysis, requirements workshops, surveys, site visits, business process descriptions, use cases, scenarios, business analysis, task and workflow analysis to analyze, design and implement business solutions for complex business problems.
  • Partner with business analysts and respective cross-functional business groups (e.g. engineering, maintenance, IT, etc) to elicit functional and non-functional requirements
  • Proactively communicates and collaborates with external and internal customers to analyze information needs and functional requirements and deliver the following artifacts as needed: functional requirements, use cases, GUI, screen and interface designs).
  • Takes a broad perspective to identify innovative business solutions that challenges the business on their assumptions of how they will successfully execute their plans.
  • Participate in defining the integration between proposed development projects and existing systems, software and hardware.
  • Ensures that systems and application designs adhere to standards and reflect the architecture appropriately.
  • Collaborates with other divisions IT leads as well as other stakeholders to align solution in support of the business' tactical and strategic plans. Aligns IT goals with business needs.
  • Researches emerging technologies and recommend technologies that will increase cost effectiveness, improve flexibility or better support business requirements.
  • Work closely with third-party vendors including software providers, implementation partners, and consultants
  • Understand existing and anticipated application functionality, including cloud-based offerings, that meet business demand.
  • Assist the team with user acceptance testing requirements for existing and new application systems and modules
  • Partner with key strategic solutions partners for small and large scale engagements to help develop the vision of the technology service
  • Manage the configuration, setup, and maintenance of application-related solutions
  • Mentors other analysts on the team by providing guidance and hands-on solving of complex problems.

Position Requirement & competencies:

Mandatory

  • Bachelor's degree in relevant field (Engineering, Computer science)
  • Experience implementing solutions for complex systems supporting business processes.
  • Experience in driving software and technology solutions in large, complex organizations.
  • Experience leading cross-functional teams and projects to drive business improvements
  • Experience in driving process and technology re-engineering using industry practices e.g., Six Sigma, Lean, Kaizen, COBIT, ITIL, CMMi
  • Business process knowledge (e.g., Plan-to-Produce process, manufacturing execution systems)
  • Manufacturing system knowledge (Maintenance, Quality, SAP Pm, SAP PP, Production, Process, SCADA, OPC)
  • Advanced English (spoken and written)

Essential Competencies:

  • Ability to be flexible about project changes and dynamically mitigate risks in the moment with mid-course corrective action
  • Strong analytical and product management skills required, including a thorough understanding of how to interpret customer business needs and translate them into application and operational requirements*
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills and ability to manage customer expectations regarding scope, schedule and budget.
  • Proven project planning and execution skills.
  • Ability to analyze and interpret data and make recommendations.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to learn new things

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

  • Location: São José dos Campos/SP (GBS)
  • Work Model: Flexible (3x on-site / 2x from home)
  • Schedule: 8:00 AM to 17:00 PM
